science_question: Can a fixed 32-bit learned *composition* of two reversible cross-byte nonlinear coupling steps transfer causal-chain discrimination without source-family tags and at equal-or-lower full process cost?

prior_evidence.BN_partial: 9/12 new reversible GF2 causal pairs correctly discriminated but 3 baseline positive losses, 0/12 nonlinear; frozen gate failed
prior_evidence.BO_partial: 12/12 new odd-modular XOR positives+hard negatives correctly paired, zero hard FP, 0/12 new Feistel, peak process RSS over eligible AZ; frozen gate failed

new_hypothesis.parameters: 4 bytes: a,b,c,d each 8 bits; a,c odd. Parameter state 32 bits (equal to earlier T1 and smaller than BO's 48 bits).
new_hypothesis.mapping: x=(lo,hi), ylo=(lo + a*hi + b) modulo 256; yhi=(hi + c*ylo + d) modulo 256. Invert via hi=(yhi-c*ylo-d) mod 256; lo=(ylo-a*hi-b) mod 256. Single composition across every source, no learned family routing.
new_hypothesis.fit: 40 public FIT and 8 public CHECK pairs per task; enumerate all 128 odd byte gains for each shear. For each gain, infer bias using the most common residual among 40 FIT pairs; deterministically retain <=4 top fits per shear. Cartesian <=16 composites. Rank only by whole-pair FIT Hamming bit errors. Use CHECK ONLY as eligibility veto, never as optimizer or tie-breaker.
new_hypothesis.budgets: <=2*128*40 residual evaluations plus <=16*40 composite evaluations; <=16 six-tuples intermediate, candidate persisted state 4 bytes (32 bits), no memorized per-graph lookup, no family key. Run complete task CPU + whole-process peak RSS and fail if >unchanged AZ on identical task.
new_hypothesis.confidence: Choose model uniquely from FIT using score + deterministic lexical ordering; require whole FIT bit errors <=6 and 8 CHECK total errors<=2; if multiple near-FIT candidate models (within 1 FIT bit of winner) each with CHECK<=2 disagree on inverse of ANY causal edge, abstain. No CHECK-based retraining, graph truth/model-specific source label, no source identity inference.
new_hypothesis.graph: native 7 active 9 retained cognition path unchanged; learned inverse applied per edge for native validation; only accept complete source-blind predecessor continuity; hard negatives share full edge token multiset and identical topology.

family_A.private_grammar: 12-18 procedural reversible byte shears algebraically collapsed into the same two-shear composed 32-bit state; independent source-only code after learner birth
family_A.hard_negative: disconnected causal predecessor via swap with same-role detached decoy, preserving full edge token inventory

family_B.private_grammar: unseen nonlinear four-round Feistel using independently keyed eight-bit algebraic round function, outside two-shear representation; negative constructed with independent source oracle
family_B.hard_negative: same topology and bit-token histogram yet source continuity broken

new_origination.external_novelty: provider GitHub blob/tree original commit can authenticate birth, not independent thirdparty novelty

acceptance.mechanism_nonconsuming: Exact original model/AST, independent procedural synthetic six-corruption task (NOT from either registered family) correct fitted params, deterministic and CHECK-only veto; OS CPU+RSS measured versus unchanged baseline on same synthetic graph; stop if identity or resource witness fails
acceptance.positive_retention: Every original AZ-accepted positive source identity must be accepted
acceptance.resource_parity: Measured complete task process CPU and peak RSS must be <= original eligible AZ per case; no median-only surrogate
acceptance.science_required: After developmental pass ONLY, two separately sourced 128-case replications +8/128 each, 0 FP, all baseline positives, full amortized resource parity, independent third-party source attestation; otherwise negative evidence.
acceptance.abstention: Abstention counts as missed correct positive; never count no-FP alone as transfer competence.
